input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First Zhang sigma_f read as 0: with CALIB_FIX_ASPECT_RATIO OpenCV reports sigma(f) in the fy slot of stdDeviationsIntrinsics; fixed before analysis.
Every target-free solve stopped on its 1,000-evaluation cap (similarity gauge slows trf); disclosed in README and LOG.

doc_friction.issue: Crossref, doi.org and arXiv all refused by the proxy (connect_rejected); every DOI in the new proposal is marked unchecked.
pick_track drew track 15 (sensing) whose seven milestones are all landed and which had no programme; nothing says whether to open a programme or extend a sensing-* project, so a programme was opened.
Recommended data hosts (ETH3D, Middlebury, BAL) are refused by the proxy; only GitHub raw worked, which limited real multi-view data to OpenCV samples.

deviations.why: Pre-registration said view subsets of 4-12; 3 was also run for completeness.
deviations.did: H2 scored on 4-12 as planned; size 3 reported separately as unplanned.

notes: Opened programme sensing-selfcal (PROPOSAL.md to the bar, row in PROGRAMMES.md). Milestone 1 on OpenCV's real stereo set: target-free BA within 0.15%/0.24% of Zhang f, sigma ratio 1.12 (H3 refuted), rms z 1.94 over 360 subsets (H2 held narrowly), board bend reconstructed identically by both cameras (r 0.90). Local checks: 5 pytest pass, build.py ok, programme_check ok, research_live_links, check_md_links, post frontmatter/links/similarity ok. No separate agent doc: the LOG.md entry carries what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a PhD student: proposal with 15 references (~6 h), BA solver with gauge-correct covariance and a 400-solve study on real images (~8 h), write-ups (~2 h)

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
